company.name: Parameter
company.shortDescription: Parameter provides unified leak detection, environmental monitoring, and battery monitoring systems for critical facilities.
company.description: Parameter provides monitoring systems that combine leak detection, environmental monitoring, and battery health tracking for critical facilities. The company offers RLE leak detection solutions using sensing cables, spot detectors, and controllers to identify fluid leaks with precise location data. Its RLE environment monitoring line includes wired, wireless, and Wi-Fi sensors and controllers, such as the WiNG-MGR platform, to track temperature, humidity, airflow, CO2, and other conditions. Through Cellwatch and Cellwatch Frontier, Parameter delivers continuous battery monitoring for UPS and utility DC systems, including hazardous and multisite environments. Additional offerings such as Triad raised flooring and F200 facility controllers support airflow optimization and facility integration. Parameter’s systems are used in data centers, hyperscale and colocation environments, and utility substations to help operators detect threats early and manage infrastructure performance.
